definitions.length: Length of all contigs in reference
definitions.numreads: Number of reads which map well to this reference (primary + supplementary)
definitions.coverage: Percentage of reference covered by reads (not including secondary alignments)
definitions.meandepth: Mean depth of coverage of reference (not including secondary alignments)
definitions.coverage_including_secondary: Percentage of reference covered by reads (including secondary alignments)
definitions.meandepth_including_secondary: Mean depth of coverage of reference (including secondary alignments)
definitions.total_reads: Total number of reads which map (in any way) to chrom
definitions.total_alns: Total number of alignments, so will count supplementary separately
definitions.exclusive_reads: reads which only maps to this chrom
definitions.primary_reads: reads which map best to this chrom
definitions.secondary_reads: reads which map to this chrom but not with primary
definitions.supplementary_reads: reads which have supplementary alignments but not primary
